questions.question: How do I access Blackboard from outside the campus?
questions.expected: Open the University website, click Quick Links MyUOS, click Login, sign in with the UOS e-mail and password, verify by multi-factor authentication (SMS or Microsoft Authenticator), then the Blackboard main page opens.

questions.question: How do I verify my identity when signing in to Blackboard?
questions.expected: Multi-factor authentication: an SMS to the registered phone number or the Microsoft Authenticator application.

questions.question: How can I pin a course to the top of my course list in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: Mark the course as a favourite; it is pinned to the top of the courses list.

questions.question: What can I manage from the Details & Actions panel of a Blackboard course?
questions.expected: Roster, groups, course image, course availability (open or private), Blackboard Collaborate, attendance, announcements.

questions.question: What is the minimum size of a Blackboard course banner image?
questions.expected: At least 1200 x 240 pixels and no larger than 25 KB (page 5); page 4 repeats the 1200 x 240 minimum.

questions.question: How do I keep a Blackboard course hidden from students while I build it?
questions.expected: Set Course Availability to Private: students see the course in their list but cannot access it; open it when ready.

questions.question: Which file types can I upload to Blackboard course content?
questions.expected: DOC, DOCX, HTM, HTML, MP3, MPG, PDF, PPT, PPTX, XLS, XLSX, RTF, TXT, ZIP and most image types.

questions.question: How do I move a content item with the keyboard in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: Tab to the item's move icon, press Enter to activate move mode, use the arrow keys to choose a location, press Enter to drop it.

questions.question: How do I add a learning module in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: Click the plus sign, click Learning Module or Folder, name it and add content; it is hidden by default and visibility can be set or conditioned.

questions.question: How do I send an announcement to my students in Blackboard?
questions.expected: Details and Actions, create Announcements, plus sign, title, recipients and message, optional e-mail copy, optional schedule, Save then Post.

questions.question: How do I create an assignment in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: On the Course Content page select the plus sign, Create, Assignment; a gradebook item is created automatically; add title, text, files, questions, visibility, due date.

questions.question: Can I add a time limit to a group assignment in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: No: at this time a time limit cannot be added to group assignments.

questions.question: How can I review my Blackboard course from a student's perspective?
questions.expected: Use student preview to review the content and validate course behaviours such as conditional release and how grades appear.

questions.question: Where do I find the course gradebook in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: Inside the course, on the navigation bar at the top right: select the Gradebook icon.

questions.question: What are the two views of the Blackboard Ultra gradebook?
questions.expected: List view (gradable items list and student list) and student grid view; toggle at the top left.

questions.question: How do I post grades to students from the Blackboard gradebook?
questions.expected: In the student grid, select the Post option in the column header when ready to release grades.

questions.question: How do I make Blackboard assign zeros to missing work automatically?
questions.expected: Gradebook Settings icon, select Assign automatic zeros for past due work, then Assign Zeros; enabled by default in new courses.

questions.question: How do I download the gradebook from Blackboard?
questions.expected: Select the down-arrow icon to open the Download Gradebook panel; choose full gradebook or columns, CSV or XLS, and the location.

questions.question: How do I set accommodations for a student in the Blackboard gradebook?
questions.expected: In the Students tab select the three-dot menu at the end of the student row and choose Accommodations; exempt from due dates or time limits.

questions.question: How do I add an attendance row to the Blackboard gradebook?
questions.expected: Select the plus sign where you want to add a row and choose Add Attendance; the option disappears once added.

questions.question: How long can the title of a gradebook item be in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: The title is limited to 255 characters.

questions.question: How do I filter the Blackboard gradebook by merged child courses?
questions.expected: In the student grid view select Filter to open the Filter Criteria panel; the filter appears only for merged courses.

questions.question: What can I change from the Gradebook Settings panel in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: The default grading schema, automatic zeros for missing past-due work, gradebook categories, rubrics.

questions.question: How do I transfer grades from Blackboard to Banner?
questions.expected: In the Grade Transfer Dashboard search the course by Course ID and Term, click View Details, click Transfer; after Chair and Dean approval the grade shows under the Banner column.

questions.question: Where is the Grade Transfer Dashboard link?
questions.expected: In the announcement on the Blackboard Institution Page, or directly at https://op.sharjah.ac.ae/GradeTransfer.

questions.question: Who approves the grade transfer to Banner?
questions.expected: The Chair and the Dean approve, by selecting Transfer in the Grade Transfer portal.

questions.question: How can I find my course in the Grade Transfer Dashboard?
questions.expected: Use the search bar at the top of the dashboard; search by Course ID and Term.

questions.question: How does a Dean approve grades in the Grade Transfer portal?
questions.expected: Open https://op.sharjah.ac.ae/GradeTransfer, log in, select the role, search and select the course, revise grades and approve by selecting Transfer.

- Open the University website http://www.sharjah.ac.ae

- You must verify your identity using the multifactor factor authentication service by receiving an SMS on the registered phone number or using Microsoft authenticator application.

- Then you will be redirected to the main page of the blackboard.

results.question: What can I do in the gradable items list of the Blackboard gradebook?
results.answer:
In the gradable items list, you can:

1. Open items: Select an item's title to open a new layer. See whose submissions need grading and who hasn't received their grades yet. Switch between Gradable Items.

2. Upload & Download grades: You can download the gradebook to modify it and upload it again.

3. Add Graded items or calculated Items.

4. Rearrange the gradebook items: Use the Arrows to rearrange items in the list

5. Check the progress: See how many submissions you need to grade and grades you have to post.

6. Add a row: Select the plus sign wherever you want to add a row:

a) Add Item: Add a row for coursework, such as a participation grade. Your title is limited to 255 characters. Choose the grade unit, such as points or letter.

b) Add Calculation: Add a row for a calculation, such as an average assignments grade.

c) Add Attendance: Add a row for attendance. After you add attendance, the add option will not appear in the menu again.

results.question: How many office hours must faculty hold, and how do I access Blackboard?
results.answer:
1. Full-Time Faculty: Full-time faculty members in academic and career/technical programs are required to schedule a minimum of five office hours per week, spread over a minimum of two days. These office hours provide dedicated time for students to discuss course- related matters, seek clarifications, and receive academic support.

How to access Blackboard:

- Open the University website http://www.sharjah.ac.ae

- Click Quick Links “MyUOS” , If you are connected to the University Network Domain, you will be directly logged in automatically.

- If you are singing from outside university campus, click on Login from the main page.

- Click on Login.

- Then sign in using your University of Sharjah email address and password.

- You must verify your identity using the multifactor factor authentication service by receiving an SMS on the registered phone number or using Microsoft authenticator application.

- Then you will be redirected to the main page of the blackboard.

In the gradable items list, you can:

1. Open items: Select an item's title to open a new layer. See whose submissions need grading and who hasn't received their grades yet. Switch between Gradable Items.

2. Upload & Download grades: You can download the gradebook to modify it and upload it again.

3. Add Graded items or calculated Items.

4. Rearrange the gradebook items: Use the Arrows to rearrange items in the list

5. Check the progress: See how many submissions you need to grade and grades you have to post.

6. Add a row: Select the plus sign wherever you want to add a row:

a) Add Item: Add a row for coursework, such as a participation grade. Your title is limited to 255 characters. Choose the grade unit, such as points or letter.

b) Add Calculation: Add a row for a calculation, such as an average assignments grade.

c) Add Attendance: Add a row for attendance. After you add attendance, the add option will not appear in the menu again.
